payload.summary: system-auditor commit step used a non-explicit git add and swept in-flight architect working-tree edits (.github/workflows/ci.yml, apps/mcp-server/bunfig.toml, apps/mcp-server/package.json, scripts/test-coverage.sh, architect decision-journal + notebook) into commit f05795c3 alongside its own notebook. Commit message claimed 'notebook tier-1 audit' but content was 7 files. Content was benign this time (architect edits were correct and headed for commit anyway) and nothing was clobbered (signal_queue intact), but this is a latent concurrent-commit-race / wrong-attribution bug that could mis-commit or clobber under different timing.
payload.evidence: git show --stat f05795c3 = 7 files; only system-auditor.md is auditor-owned. Memory: feedback_concurrent_commit_race, feedback_janitor_false_green_verify.
payload.suggested_fix: system-auditor flow commit step MUST use explicit pathspec (git commit -m <msg> -- docs/agent-memory/notebooks/system-auditor.md docs/data/orch/orch-state.json) and a commit-mutex claim to serialize against concurrent dev-team agents. Never git add -A / git add . / git commit -am.
